title: TOEIC SW Speaking Test 5 (Bản Gốc STUDY4)

tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: Hi. This is Myra Peters calling about my appointment with Dr. Jones. I have a three o’clock appointment scheduled for this afternoon. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to keep it because of an important meeting at work. So, I’ll need to reschedule. I was hoping to come in sometime next week. Any time Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday afternoon would work for me. I hope the doctor has some time available on one of those days. Please call me back and let me know.
texts: Hi. This is Myra Peters calling about my appointment with Dr. Jones. I have a three o’clock appointment scheduled for this afternoon. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to keep it because of an important meeting at work. So, I’ll need to reschedule. I was hoping to come in sometime next week. Any time Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday afternoon would work for me. I hope the doctor has some time available on one of those days. Please call me back and let me know.

Our speaker tonight is Mr. John Wilson, who has just returned from traveling in South America. Mr. Wilson spent his trip photographing scenes of small-town life across the continent. His work is well known around the world, and his photography has been featured in numerous newspapers, magazines, and books. Tonight he will share with us photographs and stories from his recent trip and will answer any questions you may have. Due to time constraints, we ask you to hold your questions until the end of the talk.
scoringFocus: Ngắt nghỉ: Nghỉ ngắn ở dấu phẩy (,) và nghỉ rõ ở cuối câu (.)
Ngữ điệu câu liệt kê và câu hỏi.
Phát âm chuẩn xác các âm đuôi (-s, -ed, -tion).

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that a marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a survey about live music and concerts.

questions.question: What kinds of concerts or live music performances do you attend?
questions.modelAnswer: I frequently attend live acoustic music concerts and outdoor jazz festivals during the summer season.

questions.question: How often do you listen to live music?
questions.modelAnswer: I listen to live music about once a month, usually on Friday evenings when local bands perform at nearby lounges.

questions.question: Describe where you go to listen to live music and why you like it there.
questions.modelAnswer: I love going to the outdoor amphitheater downtown because the acoustics are fantastic, and sitting under the open evening sky with friends creates an unforgettable musical experience.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided
What you will hear
Question 7:
Man: I’m interested in taking the tour of the Botanical Gardens on June 5, but I’m not sure exactly where I should go. Can you tell me where the tour begins?
Question 8:
Man: Can you tell me how much the tickets for the tour cost?
Question 9:
Man: I understand that the tour lasts for several hours, and I’m afraid I might get hungry in that time. Will any meals be served during the tour?

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? “Young people should not be allowed to drive cars until they are twenty-one years old.” Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
